note: Full unchanged measured-source files, two isolated production analysis workers with the same pool policy and calculation parameters. Baseline is an immutable archived production build from immediately before these core changes; optimized is the current production build. The candidate adds retained nearest-k/coordinate scratch, paired f64 SIMD leaf distances, per-channel f64 SIMD covariance, invariant M3C2 cylinder geometry and SCS neighbourhood scratch. Its worker also retains one immutable ICP reference/tree/lazy-normal cache under a 128 MiB capacity budget, and three voxel scores for one immutable pair/settings. Every coordinate edit/removal invalidates the relevant entry. Timed ICP uses the warmed reference and lazy normals; timed Map quality recomputes nearest distances/statistics/inliers and reuses matching AWD/SCS/voxel scores. First-use observations are recorded as excluded setup, not cold-start medians. Earlier prototype reports retain their original schema/fingerprints. Both reuse exact M3C2 trees and Map quality nearest preparation after excluded setup. Each method gets fresh worker contexts and full inputs; five excluded alternating warm-up pairs precede ten timed pairs unless repeats overridden. Wall times include complete computation and RPC; SOR includes output indexing and ICP includes source transformation. ICP reloads an unchanged measured moving cloud before each call, with loading excluded, then fits point-to-plane for at most ten iterations at 0.8 overlap. Normal/SOR k=24, M3C2 normal/projection/depth/core spacing=0.4/0.25/0.5/0.25 m; map voxel/minimum occupancy/inlier threshold=1 m/5/0.5 m, scalar moments. Every pair checks all normal/M3C2/display distance bits, ICP transform/RMS/iterations/convergence, exact inlier metrics/statistics and byte-identical PLY for M3C2/SOR/ICP. Map AWD/SCS retain the existing 1e-12 relative/absolute HashMap reduction tolerance. Validation/exports/cleanup and loading/pool startup/setup are outside timing; no other builds/tests/scans run concurrently. Source/manifest/both-build/script hashes are checked before/after. Two contexts retain independent trees/heaps; each existing copy budget applies separately and is not a total process-memory cap. CPU clocks, power, GC and other applications are uncontrolled. Even/odd measured-source splits are not independent surveys or accuracy/registration ground truth. No GPU adapter or model information is collected.
